args.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Count non-hidden files and directories in ~/linux_problem/sample_dir

TARGET_DIR="$HOME/linux_problem/sample_dir"

# Count regular files (excluding hidden)
file_count=$(find "$TARGET_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -not -name '.*' | wc -l)

# Count directories (excluding hidden and the directory itself)
dir_count=$(find "$TARGET_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -not -name '.*' | wc -l)

# Calculate sum
total=$((file_count + dir_count))

echo "Files: $file_count"
echo "Directories: $dir_count"
echo "Total: $total"
